note: Every translatable string on each board, in reading order, with its Arabic. kind is text, attr (aria-label, alt, placeholder or title), title (the document title) or js (copy the board script renders). status approved means the owner has seen and approved that Arabic on a board; draft means it was written for this handoff in the same voice and the owner still has to review it. Prices, sizes, codes, initials and the sample store name in Latin letters are not listed because they do not change between languages, except that prices read "3,250 ج.م" in Arabic. Chat-Arabic is Arabic by design and has no English twin.

strings.en: Can I talk to someone about changing my delivery address?

strings.en: Of course. I've passed your message and order #1042 to the team.
The team usually replies in about 10 minutes. You will see the reply here.
strings.ar: يرد الفريق عادةً خلال 10 دقائق تقريباً. سترين الرد هنا.

strings.en: If you leave, where should they reply?

strings.en: While you wait, I can still help with anything else.
strings.ar: لحد ما يردوا عليكي، أقدر أساعدك في أي حاجة تانية.

strings.ar: بعد ساعات العمل، لا أحد يتظاهر بأنه موجود

strings.en: Tell us where to reply and they will answer first thing tomorrow.
strings.ar: أخبرينا أين نرد عليكِ، وسيرد الفريق عليكِ صباح الغد مباشرة.
